sentences.text: Speed, time and distance problems are free points if you know one formula: sixty times distance equals speed times time.
Remember it as sixty D street.
Distance is in nautical miles, speed in knots, and time in minutes.
To find time, multiply sixty by the distance and divide by the speed.
To find distance, multiply speed by time and divide by sixty.
To find speed, multiply sixty by the distance and divide by the time.
Twelve miles at eight knots takes sixty times twelve, divided by eight, or ninety minutes.
